p: Uttoxeter is in a brilliant spot for a bigger day or weekend out. Alton Towers is only a short drive away for those who fancy more adrenaline after their skate, and the surrounding countryside is full of lovely walks. Make a weekend of it and you can mix the ice rink, the theme park and a bit of fresh air for a proper family break in the Staffordshire Moorlands.

If you're skating for the first time, keep things simple. Take your time getting your skates fitted, keep your knees soft, lean slightly forward and take short gliding steps. Look where you want to go, not down at your feet. Stick near the barrier while you build confidence and you'll be off and gliding before you know it.

Kids tend to pick it up quicker than adults, partly because they're closer to the ground and partly because they don't mind falling over. A pair of gloves is essential for small hands, and a change of trousers in the car can be a lifesaver if they've spent half the session sitting on the ice.

Back in town, Uttoxeter is a traditional market town with a relaxed feel, and it's a nice place to grab a bite after your session. Rocester, just up the road, is home to JCB's headquarters and its landscaped lakes, which you'll spot if you're driving that way. All in all, a handy base for a varied day out in east Staffordshire.
